optimized_sql:
WITH date_filtered AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1217 AND 1217 + 11
),
agg_sales AS (
  SELECT ss_item_sk, ss_store_sk, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy,
         sum(coalesce(ss_sales_price * ss_quantity, 0)) AS sumsales
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN date_filtered ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_filtered.d_date_sk
  GROUP BY ss_item_sk, ss_store_sk, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy
),
rolled AS (
  SELECT i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id,
         sum(agg_sales.sumsales) AS sumsales
  FROM agg_sales
  JOIN store ON agg_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk
  JOIN item ON agg_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
  GROUP BY ROLLUP(i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id)
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, sumsales,
         rank() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY sumsales DESC) AS rk
  FROM rolled
)
SELECT i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, sumsales, rk
FROM ranked
WHERE rk <= 100
ORDER BY i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, sumsales, rk
LIMIT 100
